title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and set the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw a single circle with its center at zero point zero one seven, zero point zero one seven and a radius of zero point zero one seven. Apply a scaling factor of zero point zero three four one to the first two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the Euler angles of negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and translate it using the translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. Extrude the sketch towards the normal by zero point seven five units without extruding in the opposite direction of the normal. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body with this extrusion. The dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of zero point zero three four zero seven one four two eight five seven one four two eight five seven units, a width of zero point zero three four zero seven one four two eight five seven one four two eight five seven units, and a height of zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the sketch
circle_center = (0.017, 0.017)
circle_radius = 0.017

# Create the sketch on the XY plane
r = r.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the cylinder 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circle
center = (0.017, 0.017)
radius = 0.017

# Create a circle in the XY plane
r = r.center(*center).circle(radius)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the cylinder 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)
